provenance.l: Mars 2020 MEADS reconstruction (NASA) — entry 128.22 km, 5,333.6 m/s at −16.18°; chute 240.6 s at 10.04 km MOLA (12.6 km above the −2.56 km site), backshell separation 357.5 s, touchdown 418.7 s at 0.83 m/s. L/D is the bank-averaged effective value (estimate)

Perseverance as researched for pass 2 (docs/wip/2026-11-23-mars-landings-record.md): 21.5 m chute (Range Trigger), heat shield 20 s after it, terrain-relative navigation between 4.2 and 2.2 km (the window ends at the backshell separation, 2.22 km in this profile; the start is placed at 4.2 km). The record puts the chute at about 11 km against 12.6 km here: not changed
